items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Can we cover Chalamet or...? [INTERVIEWER] We go after Chalamet. They're kind of rough down there. They're pretty rough on us when we don't play their requests. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.
